# testing-os

> Atlas, the repository mapper in testing-os, reads a repository and says from it alone what comes in, what runs and what is written where. Each week it renders every public repository of dogfood-lab and mcp-tool-shop-org that has adopted it, and publishes that fleet as plain text for agents.

## Atlas

- [The published fleet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dogfood-lab/testing-os/atlas-render/indexes/atlas/llms.txt): one line per rendered repository, with links to its page as markdown and as page.json
